## Overview

- **Source**: ColorLib Bootstrap Buttons 10 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/bootstrap-buttons-10/`)
- **New App Name**: `bootstrap-buttons-ten`
- **Design Category**: UI Component Showcase / Buttons

## Section Order & Structure

1. **Header / Hero Section**: Title, subtitle, and badge highlighting gradient and shadow button styles.
2. **Gradient Buttons Grid**: Multi-stop gradient buttons with smooth hover transitions.
3. **Shadow & Elevation Showcase**: Elevated buttons with colored shadows and depth effects.
4. **Pill & Rounded Shapes**: Fully rounded pills and large CTA buttons.
5. **Interactive Code Snippets**: Copy-to-clipboard cards for each button variant.
6. **Footer**: Branded footer with link to `https://www.componentdock.com/`.

## Design Notes

- Clean neutral background (`bg-slate-50`) with white component cards.
- Rich vibrant color palette leveraging Tailwind v4 color tokens and gradients.
- Fully responsive grid layout across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
- 100% test coverage required during implementation.
